meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为视频合成添加关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做动画合成时需要精确调节关键帧。
copy.tagline_en: Add precise keyframe animations to video compositions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you craft animation compositions and need precise keyframe control.

howto.what: 在你需要为 HyperFrames 合成添加关键帧动画时，Claude 会编写并验证 seek-safe 的动画代码（如 GSAP、CSS、Anime.js），选择最简机制，遵守可见状态、对象连续性与最终帧等约定，并通过 lint、check 等命令确认动画像素正确。
howto.when: 当用户要求为视频作品添加关键帧动画、路径动画、SVG 变形等，或要求运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断时触发。

say.text: 帮我给卡片添加从左上角到右下角的 GSAP 关键帧动画。
让这个 SVG 路径有描边生长效果，用 DrawSVG。
say.note: Claude 会按 SVG 最佳实践实现描边动画。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断当前合成。
say.note: Claude 会执行诊断并解读结果。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude creates and verifies seek-safe keyframe animations for HyperFrames compositions, choosing the smallest mechanism (e.g., GSAP, CSS, Anime.js) and confirming pixel correctness via lint/check commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for seek-safe keyframes, path animations, SVG morphing, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics.

say_en.text: Add a GSAP keyframe animation moving this card from top-left to bottom-right.
say_en.note: Claude generates a seek-safe timeline and verifies it.

say_en.text: Animate this SVG path with a stroke-draw effect.
Run hyperframes keyframes diagnostics on the current composition.
say_en.note: Claude runs diagnostics and explains the output.
